verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs show natural-language AI in specific areas: building reports and dashboards (shown with the prompt "Show me headcount vs plan"), and letting employees get answers, compare plans and submit qualifying life events with AI. Nothing shows natural-language commands driving the product broadly, such as running payroll, onboarding or changing permissions. missing for 10: natural-language control across core admin actions (payroll, onboarding, workflows, permissions), detailed first-party docs on the AI command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use AI to build reports and dashboards on labor cost trends, overtime by location, and more.
a prompt reading "Show me headcount vs plan."
